cases.title: Verify Logged Cases Are Displayed on the Map

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Case Mapping screen is displayed with the map.
Cases with valid locations are displayed as pins on the map.

steps.action: Select a case pin on the map.
steps.expected: The selected case is highlighted and its case information is displayed

cases.title: Verify Cases Can Be Filtered by Channel

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Case Mapping screen is displayed.
The available Channel filter options are displayed.
The selected Channel is applied as the filter criterion.
The map refreshes and displays only cases associated with the selected Channel.

cases.title: Verify Cases Can Be Filtered by Category and Case Type

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Case Mapping screen is displayed.
The available Category options are displayed.
The selected Category is applied and the Case Type options are populated based on the selected Category.
The selected Case Type is accepted as a filter criterion.
The map refreshes and displays only cases matching the selected Category and Case Type.

cases.title: Verify Cases Can Be Filtered by Reported Date

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Case Mapping screen is displayed
The Reported Date filter options/fields are displayed

steps.action: Specify the date and time from the date picker
steps.expected: Specified time and date should be displayed
The map refreshes and displays only cases matching the selected reported date criteria.

cases.title: Verify Multiple Case Mapping Filters Can Be Applied

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Case Mapping screen is displayed.

steps.action: Select a Channel from the channel dropdown
steps.expected: The selected channel is displayed

steps.action: Select a Status from the dropdown
steps.expected: Selected status is displayed

steps.action: Select a priority from the dropdown
steps.expected: Selected Priority is specified

steps.action: Select a Category and its corresponding Case Type.
steps.expected: The selected Category and cascading Case Type are applied.

steps.action: Specify the date and time from the date picker
steps.expected: Specified date and time are displayed

cases.title: Verify Case Details Are Displayed When a Case Location Is Hovered Over or Selected

steps.action: Log in to the Admin Portal using valid credentials.
steps.expected: User is successfully logged in.
The Case Mapping screen is displayed with case location icons

steps.action: Hover over a case location icon on the map.
steps.expected: A case information dialog is displayed for the selected case.

steps.action: Review the information displayed in the dialog.
steps.expected: The dialog displays the correct Reference, Status, Received Date, Address, and Description for the case.
